# Virtual Library

**Virtual Library is a gateway to high-impact experiential learning.**

It is a growing collection of educational VR modules designed to support specific learning goals and outcomes.

To provide a clearer understanding of its offerings, we have defined three types of experiences within Virtual Library: **Learning Environment, Training Lesson, and Research Experiment.**
